name: A failed turn is a failure, however upbeat its message
case: The agent's tests fail and it ends its turn anyway, cheerfully saying it's all done and working great: the turn counts as failed, and Boop plays a failure, never a success. Later a turn fails outright on an error, with no message at all: a failure again.
why: No code overrides a failed turn; NOW's line already says it failed (a turn whose last check failed counts as failed), and react.move's success isn't for a failed turn, whatever its message says

steps.message: All done! Everything is working great now.
